messages.content: "In a park, there is a rectangular playground with a length of 50 meters and a width of 30 meters. Next to it, there is a square sandbox with a side length of 5 meters. A circular fountain with a radius of 3 meters is located at the center of the park. Can you calculate the area and perimeter of the playground, the area and perimeter of the sandbox, and the area and circumference of the fountain?"

function.description: Calculates the area and perimeter of a rectangle given the width and length. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: geometry_circle_calculate
function.description: Calculates the area and circumference of a circle given the radius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: geometry_square_calculate
function.description: Calculates the area and perimeter of a square given the side length. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
